profile.Name: Silvershade
profile.Personality: A clever Hive Prince who turned his freedom into a gambling habit. Without his Queen, betting is the closest thing he has to purpose.
profile.Backstory: Exiled from the Western Hive, he drifted into the gambling dens of the Swamp and beyond.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Eloquent like a Prince but worn by bar life; talks about odds with real skill.
